## 3. Projects Catalog

### Smart School Management System (SSMS)
- **Status**: Under Progress / Active Development
- **Category**: Full-Stack Web Application
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, Supabase PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, @react-pdf/renderer
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/shanaya-mahendran/Smart-School
- **Description**: An enterprise-grade, multi-role School Management System featuring 4 dedicated portals (Admin, Teacher, Student, Parent).
- **Key Features**:
  - Role-based cookie session security with bcryptjs.
  - Live analytics dashboard for total students, faculty, fee metrics, and area charts.
  - Student registrar, atomic enrollment transactions, and bulk grade promotion.
  - Interactive schedule builder with Supabase Realtime live grid synchronization.
  - Subject-scoped attendance marking with absence reason tracking.
  - Exam registry with auto-calculated letter grades (A+ to F) and 4.0 GPA computation.
  - Financial suite: fee structure definitions, bulk invoice generation, scholarship awards, and offline payment recording.
  - Client-side PDF generation engine for QR-coded Student ID cards and official Academic Report Cards.

### Sara — Modern E-Commerce Platform
- **Status**: Under Progress / Active Development
- **Category**: Full-Stack Web Application
- **Tech Stack**: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, Docker, Vite, Vitest, WebSockets, FAISS, Transformers
- **Live Demo**: https://sara-001.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/shanaya-mahendran/Sara
- **Description**: Full-stack e-commerce platform featuring 32 real products, responsive 4-column grid, JWT authentication, AI visual similarity search (FAISS + Transformers), real-time shared cart via WebSockets, multi-step checkout, PWA support, and 117 test files (988 unit tests) with Vitest.

### CabXpert — Vehicle Reservation System
- **Status**: Completed
- **Category**: Full-Stack / Java Enterprise
- **Tech Stack**: Java EE, Jersey (JAX-RS), MySQL, JDBC, Maven, Bootstrap
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Shanaya-Mahendran
- **Description**: Automated vehicle reservation system built for Mega City Cab using Java RESTful Web Services and Test-Driven Development (TDD). Manages driver and car scheduling, automated booking workflows, and billing management.

### Elegant Notes — PWA
- **Status**: Completed
- **Category**: Web Application / PWA
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Supabase, Tiptap Editor, Zustand
- **Live Demo**: https://elegant-notes-demo.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/shanaya-mahendran/elegant-notes
- **Description**: Offline-first note-taking Progressive Web App with Service Worker caching, Supabase real-time cloud synchronization, secure authentication, and a rich Tiptap editor with complex formatting.

### PTET Web (Social Summer of Code 2026)
- **Status**: Completed / Open Source Contribution
- **Category**: Open Source
- **Tech Stack**: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Sequelize
- **GitHub PRs**: https://github.com/AnthropicBots/ptet-web/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3Ashanaya-mahendran
- **Description**: Open-source contributor with 43+ merged pull requests. Built backend APIs (Daily Tip, Study Materials CRUD, Recommendations, Bookmark), implemented full-stack features, and improved dark/light theme accessibility.

### Personal Web Portfolio 🚀
- **Status**: Completed
- **Category**: Full-Stack Web Application
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Prisma, Framer Motion, Vanilla CSS
- **Live Demo**: https://shanaya-paul.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/shanaya-mahendran/Portfolio
- **Description**: Modern, high-performance personal portfolio featuring Framer Motion page transitions, an interactive HTML5 Canvas hero particle networking simulation, a glassmorphism dark/light theme engine, Prisma database schema integration, and 100 Lighthouse performance scores.

### My Educational Website
- **Status**: Completed
- **Category**: Web Application
- **Tech Stack**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Responsive Design
- **Live Demo**: https://my-web-project-iaii.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/shanaya-mahendran/my-web-project-iaii

### SLIA Database Management
- **Status**: Completed
- **Category**: Data Management / Database
- **Tech Stack**: SQLite, Data Management, Google Forms
- **Description**: Developed and maintained an SQLite database for member practice registration of 700+ members at Sri Lanka Institute of Architects. Processed member updates via Google Forms and coordinated communications.

### Learning Journal Projects (Day 01 to Day 22)
- **Day 01**: Java Basics — Quiz Game (CLI quiz with input validation, instant feedback, score summary).
- **Day 02**: Java — Library Management System (HashMap inventory lookups, borrow/return workflows).
- **Day 03**: Java OOP — Student Management System (Encapsulation, static data control, duplicate ID validation).
- **Day 04**: Java — Stock Analysis (Primitive arrays vs ArrayList benchmark, average price, max price, cumulative sum).
- **Day 05**: Java — University Enrollment & Grade System (Course registration capacity check, grade assignments 0-100, GPA).
- **Day 06**: Java — Car Rental Agency System (Polymorphic vehicle rental engine, interfaces, class inheritance).
- **Day 07**: Java Swing GUI — Student Management System (Tabbed interface, CRUD operations, auto IDs, 4.0 GPA scale).
- **Day 08**: Python — CLI & GUI Calculator Suite (Dual-mode CLI/Tkinter calculator with division-by-zero handling).
- **Day 09**: Java Swing GUI — Library Management System (Object serialization, title/author search filtering, stock control).
- **Day 10**: Java Swing GUI — Car Rental Agency System (GUI vehicle inventory, polymorphic storage).
- **Day 11**: Python — TaskFlow Pro To-Do List (CustomTkinter GUI, persistent file storage, dark/light themes).
- **Day 12**: Java — Functional Programming & Stream API (Lambda expressions, stream pipelines, Optional, parallel stream benchmarks).
- **Day 13**: Python — Number Guessing Game (Tkinter GUI, hint engine, attempt counter, keyboard shortcuts).
- **Day 14**: Python — Secure Password Generator (Secrets module, length slider 8-50, 1-click clipboard copy).
- **Day 15**: Python — Rock Paper Scissors Game (CustomTkinter arcade game, AI opponent, score persistence).
- **Day 16**: Java — Text Analysis Tool (HashMap/HashSet text frequency analysis, word/character counts).
- **Day 17**: Python — Weather App (Open-Meteo REST API, geocoding city lookup, WMO weather emoji mapping).
- **Day 18**: Java Swing GUI — Generic Library Catalog System (Java Generics `Catalog<T>`, CardLayout navigation).
- **Day 19**: Java Swing GUI — Multithreaded Clock Application (Thread synchronization, daemon threads, `invokeLater`).
- **Day 20**: Java Swing GUI — E-Commerce System (Product catalog, shopping cart, stock management, order pipelines).
- **Day 21**: Java — Online Chat Application (TCP socket programming, multi-client support, multithreaded handlers).
- **Day 22**: Java Swing — Weather Application (MVC architecture, OpenWeatherMap API, Gson JSON parsing, 5-day forecast).
